thread:
Priya Shah: opened a tiny PR to add an air-gapped checklist for Private install (KMS/HSM, certs, offline bundles). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512
Marco Diaz: good call. please add a short section on verifying KMS reachability without DNS (some customers use host entries). include netcat and curl raw IP examples.
Priya Shah: adding examples: `nc -vz 10.10.5.12 443` and `curl -v --connect-timeout 5 https://10.10.5.12:443 --resolve "kms.internal:443:10.10.5.12"`
Leah Kim: include an openssl one-liner for cert chain inspection: `openssl s_client -connect 10.10.5.12:443 -servername kms.internal -showcerts` and a note to check for missing intermediate CA.
Marco Diaz: also add a short HSM device checklist: `ls -l /dev/hsm0`, udev rule example, and a tiny systemd permission note for the installer process. keep it minimal.
Priya Shah: udev sample:
```
# /etc/udev/rules.d/99-redwood-hsm.rules
KERNEL=="hsm0", SUBSYSTEM=="char", MODE="0660", GROUP="hsm", OWNER="root"
```
Added systemd snippet for proxy/env override:
```
# /etc/systemd/system/offline-installer.service.d/proxy.conf
[Service]
Environment=HTTP_PROXY=http://proxy:3128 HTTPS_PROXY=http://proxy:3128 NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1,kms.internal,10.10.0.0/16
```
Leah Kim: suggest a short SELinux debug hint: show `ausearch -m avc -ts recent | audit2allow -M redwood_hsm` but warn customers to review generated policy.
Marco Diaz: offline bundle and checksum note please. customers in air-gapped envs need the tarball plus a sha256. add sample `sha256sum redwood-offline-1.1.0.tar.gz > redwood-offline-1.1.0.tar.gz.sha256` and installer will validate if file present.
Priya Shah: added a brief section: "Adding customer CA to trust store" with a one-liner for Debian/Ubuntu: `sudo cp customer.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/ && sudo update-ca-certificates` and a CentOS hint using `update-ca-trust`.
Marco Diaz: tiny request: in the KMS TLS note, call out SNI mismatch when connecting via IP. include `-servername` in openssl and curl `--resolve` example you added.
Priya Shah: done. I also added a small troubleshooting log excerpt from a staging dry-run (10.220.11.9) showing the two common failures we saw.
Leah Kim: paste the log?
Priya Shah: log:
```
2026-04-02T07:11:02Z installer: offline dry-run start
2026-04-02T07:11:04Z network: nc 10.10.5.12:443 -> connected
2026-04-02T07:11:05Z tls: openssl -> depth=0 C = US, ST = CA, O = Acme -> verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
2026-04-02T07:11:06Z kms: PKCS11_OpenSession() failed: CKR_PIN_INCORRECT
2026-04-02T07:11:07Z installer: dry-run completed with warnings
```
Marco Diaz: notes: missing CA fix = add CA to trust store. CKR_PIN_INCORRECT often means HSM token PIN not provisioned in test envs; add a line about verifying token initialization and that installer won't auto-provision PINs.
Leah Kim: also include a tiny note about file permissions for the offline bundle extraction path (`chown -R redwood:redwood /var/lib/redwood`) and a warning about not loosening perms on /dev/hsm0 beyond 660.

Priya Shah: thanks all 3 pushing update to the PR now, will ping when CI green and then merge.
